name: Phase 5E Temporal Semantics and Future-Edge Leakage Prevention

timezone_standard.format: ISO-8601 UTC strictly enforced across all timestamps
timezone_standard.naive_datetime_handling: Automatically normalized with .replace(tzinfo=UTC) to prevent TypeError swallows in feature calculations

future_edge_leakage_invariants.rule: For any point-in-time query with cutoff as_of = T, no relationship e with created_at > T may participate in path discovery, clustering, cycle detection, or GNN tensor construction.

point_in_time_api_coverage.enforcement: BFS traversal drops edges with rel.created_at > as_of; Cypher adds all(rel IN relationships(r) WHERE rel.created_at <= $as_of)
Node discovery BFS, edge inclusion, and local cluster detection filter out any edges created after as_of
Directed DFS cycle finder only considers edges created on or before as_of; Cypher limits path relationships
Strictly restricts relationships to the temporal window [as_of - window_hours, as_of], eliminating ancient edges and future bursts
Excludes future edges (e_time > as_of) and computes exponential decay relative to as_of: age_seconds = (as_of - e_time)
Prunes sliding window relative to stream timestamp (as_of) rather than wall-clock time, enabling reproducible simulation replay
